records.subject: Reference wire added to traditional 3 omega method
records.quote: With the newly developed two-wire 3 omega method proven to eliminate the end effect by introducing a reference wire to the traditional 3 omega method, the influence of additional polar solvents (water, ethylene glycol and ethanol) and temperature on the thermal conductivity of three ILs (1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanoamide, 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide and 1-butyl3-methylimidazolium trifluoromethansulfonate) are investigated.

records.object: Thermal conductivity of the three ILs
records.conditions: Two-wire 3 omega measurements of 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanoamide, 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide and 1-butyl3-methylimidazolium trifluoromethansulfonate; added solvents considered: water, ethylene glycol and ethanol; reduction specified for solvents with lower thermal conductivity.
